During FY 2025-26, the Government approved Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0, extending the Mission up to December 2028 with an enhanced total outlay of ₹8.69 lakh crore, including Central assistance of ₹3.59 lakh crore, with greater emphasis on sustainable and reliable rural piped drinking water services.
